title: chromamancer theme v1
description: Validates the JSON value inside themes/*/theme.jsonc (JSONC on disk). v1: Base16 tokens, fonts, optional assets, optional per-target targets{} (mappings, apply_quick, apply_nix, overrides, logic). Builtin Rust adapters supply defaults and imperative behavior; the theme file extends or replaces declaratively.

name.description: Theme id (often matches directory name under themes/).

version.description: Theme pack revision (authoring), not the schema revision.

tokens.description: Canonical Base16 palette. Keys base00..base0F; values #RRGGBBAA.

fonts.description: Global font family names only (no sizes).

assets.description: Paths relative to theme pack directory unless noted otherwise.

targets.description: Per-target mapping and apply-mode config. Keys = target ids (hyprland, kitty, …). See SPEC.md (Theme document / targets).

mappings.description: Declarative map from Base16 keys (or semantic slots) to this target’s config model—shape defined per adapter.

apply_quick.description: Optional settings used only for apply-quick (e.g. paths, fragments). Omitted → adapter defaults.

apply_nix.description: Optional settings used only for apply-nix (e.g. relative paths inside the Nix tree). Omitted → adapter defaults.

logic.description: Optional builtin logic hook id (e.g. adapter-specific transforms). Format TBD per adapter.

overrides.description: Deep-merged over the rendered config after mappings + builtin logic; same merge rules as SPEC.

RgbaHex.description: RGB + alpha, eight hex digits after #.
